subject: Fiscal sponsor and procurement path for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's perf/ROI discussion

Alex — thanks for taking the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum as you evaluate Redwood for the pilot.

Summary of call:
- Pilot goal: reduce inference cost for interactive features and keep 95th percentile latency under 300ms for the primary user path.
- Primary evaluation criteria: cost per 1M tokens, tail latency, and ability to run in your VPC for regulated data.
- Security asks: SOC 2 attestation, DPA, encryption in transit at rest, and an outline of our retention model.

Immediate asks from your side: can you confirm who will sign off on budget (economic buyer) and who handles vendor security and procurement? You mentioned a finance/ops owner might be involved. If you can introduce them, we can prepare a short mutual action plan that maps deliverables to owners and dates.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached as redwood-MAP-template.xlsx):
1) Security questionnaire returned to CloudBridge procurement (we can pre-fill answers) — target: 1 week
2) Pilot config + perf test plan with Dev — target: 2 weeks
3) Commercial estimate and PO process clarified — target: 1 week after procurement intro

Attachments included: redwood-MAP-template.xlsx (MAP), SOC2-snapshot.pdf (attestation summary).

If the timeline looks reasonable, can you introduce the person who controls budget and cc procurement? Marissa (AE) and Dev (SE) will join the intro to walk through scope and technical details.

Thanks,
Soojin
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's perf/ROI discussion

Thanks Soojin, great recap. We liked the demo and the performance numbers looked promising. A few clarifications from our side:

- Economic buyer: likely Dana Lee, our CFO (cc info below). She owns approval for platform spend above our threshold.
- Procurement/security: procurement@cloudbridge.com handles vendor onboarding and will send a standard vendor questionnaire. Legal will want to see a DPA and any redlineable contract.
- Timeline: we are targeting Q4 approval for pilots that land under $100k; anything above that will require Dana's signoff.

I have cc'd Dana on this thread and will loop in procurement in a separate email so they can share the questionnaire and PO process. I will attach a short scope excerpt that lists the expected usage pattern for the pilot.

Alex Turner
Director, Platform Engineering
CloudBridge
alex.turner@cloudbridge.com

On behalf of CloudBridge — sending initial scope file: cloudbridge-scope.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana.lee@cloudbridge.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's perf/ROI discussion

Dana — thanks for joining this thread. Hi, I m Soojin on the Redwood team; Alex and I discussed a 4-week pilot to validate cost and latency with a small user cohort. To make the intro productive, here are two quick asks:

1) Can procurement share the vendor questionnaire and PO thresholds so we can route internal approvals correctly?
2) If you are the fiscal sponsor for this spend, can you confirm the target budget bucket and any internal gates we should be aware of?

We will:
- Pre-fill the procurement questionnaire and return it within 5 business days.
- Share a short SOW and a one-page security summary (SOC2 snapshot attached).
- Provide a commercial estimate for the pilot by EOD Friday once you confirm the approximate budget range.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Procurement intro and questionnaire (Alex to introduce procurement)
- Redwood returns prepopulated questionnaire and proposed SOW (target: Dec 3)
- Schedule a 30-minute intro with Dana and procurement week of Dec 6 to align approval path

Marissa and Dev are on the thread to support commercial and technical follow-up.

Best,
Soojin
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement <procurement@cloudbridge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Dana Lee <dana.lee@cloudbridge.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: CloudBridge vendor onboarding questionnaire and PO process

Hello Soojin and team — we reviewed the scope Alex shared. Attached are our standard onboarding items: CB_vendor_questionnaire.pdf and PO_process-overview.docx. A few notes:

- Please complete sections 1-4 of the questionnaire and provide SOC2 attestation and DPA language. We need a technical contact for encryption and key management questions.
- Our PO threshold: any contract value above $100,000 requires CFO approval and formal procurement review. Pilots under $100k can be approved by the Engineering director with a simple PO.
- Standard timeline: procurement review typically takes 5 business days after we receive a completed questionnaire and the SOW.

We d appreciate a prefilled questionnaire and a named technical contact. Once we have that, we will circulate a redlineable contract and outline next steps for payment terms.

Regards,
CloudBridge Procurement Team
procurement@cloudbridge.com

Attachments: CB_vendor_questionnaire.pdf, PO_process-overview.docx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Internal: next actions on CloudBridge procurement intro

Quick internal note after procurement s response — copying the key asks and next actions:

Key asks from procurement:
- Complete procurement questionnaire (sections 1-4)
- Provide SOC2 attestation and DPA wording
- Name a technical contact for encryption/KMS questions

Proposed Redwood actions:
1) Marissa: prepare commercial estimate and two tier options (pilot under $100k, pilot with expansion scenario) by Dec 3.
2) Dev: take point on technical answers and KMS/encryption notes; I ll attach a prefilled doc named prepopulated-CB-answers.docx and send to procurement. Target: Dec 3.
3) I will schedule a 30-minute alignment with Dana and procurement for week of Dec 6 (suggest Dec 7 at 10am PT) and prepare a short one-page SOW.

If that plan looks good I ll proceed with the questionnaire prep and draft SOW.

Thanks,
Soojin
